text_zhCN:
[interrupt] → 当本议案即将从档案库以外其他区域加入潜袭者的分数区时，改为以附载4枚议案指示物的状态加入潜袭者的分数区。
只要本议案以附载1枚或更多议案指示物的状态位于潜袭者的分数区，其价值便为0点议案分数并获得“当潜袭者的回合开始时，移除1枚所附载的议案指示物。”

text_enUS: [click], [trash]: Gain [click][click].
text_zhCN: [click]，[trash]：获得[click][click]。

text_enUS:
You can advance this asset.
When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, you may pay 3[credit] to do X core damage. X is equal to the number of hosted advancement counters.
text_zhCN:
你可以推进本资产。
当潜袭者读取已安装的本资产时，你可以花费3[credit]，以造成X点核心伤害。X等于所附载的推进指示物的数量。

text_enUS: Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. When the Runner trashes this asset, you may install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. You cannot install that card in the root of this server.
text_zhCN: 每回合限一次 → [click]：从总部安装1张卡牌，忽略所有的费用。 当潜袭者销毁本资产时，你可以从总部安装1张卡牌，忽略所有的费用。你不能将该卡牌安装到本服务器的根目录。

text_enUS:
[subroutine] You may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
[subroutine] You may install 1 card from Archives or HQ, ignoring all costs.
text_zhCN:
[subroutine] 你可以将1张卡牌从档案库加入总部。
[subroutine] 你可以从档案库或总部安装1张卡牌，忽略所有的费用。

text_enUS: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. The Corp gets +1 allotted [click] for their next turn. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 2 core damage. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card. Gain 3[credit]. [subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN: 失去[click]：破解1条本防火墙上的子进程。公司在其下回合获得的起始[click]数量+1。只有潜袭者可以使用本能力。 [subroutine] 造成2点核心伤害。 [subroutine] 销毁1张已安装的潜袭者卡牌。获得3[credit]。 [subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. Each piece of ice gets +2 strength. The Runner cannot use non-icebreaker cards to break subroutines.
text_zhCN: 只有当前没有正在生效的封锁时，才能打出。直到你的下回合开始前，本事务不会被销毁。 所有防火墙的强度+2。 潜袭者不能使用非破解器卡牌破解子进程。

text_enUS: Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn. Trace[7]. If successful, remove 1 installed chip or virtual card from the game.
text_zhCN: 只有潜袭者在其上回合进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。 追踪 7 -如果成功，将1张已安装的芯片或虚拟卡牌移出游戏。

text_enUS: Remote server only. The first time each turn you install a card in the root of this server, gain 2[credit] or draw 1 card. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在远程服务器。 每回合你第一次安装一张卡牌到本服务器的根目录时，获得2[credit]或抽1张卡牌。 每个服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, place 5 agenda counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted agenda counter: Reveal the top card of R&D. Draw 2 cards. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，放置5枚议案指示物到本议案上。 每回合限一次 → 所附载的议案指示物：展示研发中心顶端的卡牌。抽2张卡牌。将1张卡牌从总部加入到研发中心顶端。

text_enUS: [interrupt] → Whenever you would do 1 or more net damage, you may prevent 1 net damage. If you do, place 1 power counter on this asset and gain 3[credit]. [click][click], [trash]: Do 1 net damage for each hosted power counter.
text_zhCN: [interrupt] → 每当你将要造成1点或更多网域伤害时，你可以防止1点网域伤害。如果你如此做，放置1枚能量指示物到本资产上并获得3[credit]。 [click][click]，[trash]：每有1枚所附载的能量指示物，造成1点网域伤害。

text_enUS:
When the Runner encounters this ice, choose a card type. For the remainder of the encounter, whenever you reveal the grip with a subroutine on this ice, you may trash 1 revealed card of the chosen type.
[subroutine] Reveal the grip.
[subroutine] Reveal the grip.
text_zhCN:
当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，你选择一种卡牌类型。本次遭遇的剩余时间内，每当你以本防火墙上的子进程展示操控器时，你可以销毁1张具有所选择类型的被展示卡牌。
[subroutine] 展示操控器。
[subroutine] 展示操控器。

text_enUS: When the Runner encounters this ice, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, you may choose another rezzed piece of ice. The Runner encounters that ice. (When that encounter ends, if the run has not ended, finish encountering this ice.)
text_zhCN: 当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，进行一次灵能博弈。（双方玩家秘密决定0-2的数值，然后同时宣告并花费所声明数值的[credit]。）如果两者数值不同，你可以选择另一层已激活的防火墙。潜袭者遭遇该防火墙。（当该遭遇结束时，如果潜袭没有终止，完成遭遇本防火墙。）

text_enUS: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. When you play this operation, choose a server. Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on the chosen server, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, end the run.
text_zhCN: 只有当前没有正在生效的封锁时，才能打出。直到你的下回合开始前，本事务不会被销毁。 当你打出本事务时，选择一台服务器。 每当潜袭者对所选服务器进行一次成功的潜袭时，进行一次灵能博弈。（双方玩家秘密决定0-2的数值，然后同时宣告并花费所声明数值的[credit]。）如果两者数值不同，终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click][click].
Trash any number of cards from HQ. Turn all cards in Archives facedown. You may install 1 card from Archives in the root of a remote server and place 2 advancement counters on it.
Remove this operation from the game.
text_zhCN:
作为打出本事务的额外费用，花费[click][click]。
从总部销毁任意数量的卡牌。将档案库中的所有卡牌翻至面朝下。你可以从档案库安装一张卡牌到一台远程服务器的根目录并放置2枚推进指示物到该卡牌上。
将本事务移出游戏。

text_enUS: Remote server only. When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a card in the root of this server. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在远程服务器。 当你的回合开始时，放置1枚推进指示物到本服务器内的1张卡牌上。 每个服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: Whenever a Corp card ability causes the Runner to spend or lose at least 1[credit] during a run, gain 1[credit].
text_zhCN: 每当一项公司卡牌能力导致潜袭者在潜袭中花费或失去至少1[credit]时，获得1[credit]。

text_enUS:
As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must pay 5[credit].
When you score this agenda, gain 5[credit].
text_zhCN:
作为窃取本议案的额外费用，潜袭者必须支付5[credit]。
当你将本议案计分时，获得5[credit]。

text_enUS: 2[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability, and only if they are not tagged. [subroutine] Add 1 installed Runner card to the grip. [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
text_zhCN: 2[credit]：破解1条本防火墙上的子进程。只有未被锁定的潜袭者可以使用本能力。 [subroutine] 将1张已安装的潜袭者卡牌加入操控器。 [subroutine] 给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记。

text_enUS:
Whenever the Runner breaks a printed subroutine on this ice, they lose 1[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 3[credit].
text_zhCN:
每当潜袭者破解1条本防火墙上的印刷子进程时，其失去1[credit]。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者支付3[credit]。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者支付3[credit]。

text_enUS: Play only if the Runner did not make a successful run on HQ during their last turn. Search R&D for 1 agenda and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that agenda to HQ. You may install 1 card from HQ in the root of a remote server. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.
text_zhCN:
只有潜袭者在其上回合未对总部进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。
在研发中心搜寻1个议案并展示之。(在搜寻研发中心后将其洗混。)将该议案加入总部。你可以安装1张卡牌到一台远程服务器内。你在本回合剩余时间内不能将议案计分。

text_enUS: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. Whenever a run begins, give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4[credit].
text_zhCN: 只有当前没有正在生效的封锁时，才能打出。直到你的下回合开始前，本事务不会被销毁。 每当一次潜袭开始时，给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记，除非其支付4[credit]。

text_enUS:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade, you may trash it to choose a rezzed piece of ice protecting this server. The Runner encounters that ice.
text_zhCN:
在潜袭者从研发中心读取本升级的期间，其必须展示之。
当潜袭者读取本升级时，你可以销毁之，以选择一层保护本服务器的已激活防火墙。潜袭者遭遇该防火墙。

text_enUS: Limit 1 remote server. As an additional cost to run HQ, the Runner must pay 1[credit]. [click]: Flip this identity. Back: Earth Station: Ascending to Orbit Limit 1 remote server. As an additional cost to run a remote server, the Runner must pay 6[credit]. When the Runner makes a successful run on HQ, flip this identity.
text_zhCN: 限制1台远程服务器。 作为潜袭总部的额外费用，潜袭者必须支付1[credit]。 [click]：将本特性翻面。 翻面 地球站：升入空轨 限制1台远程服务器。 作为潜袭远程服务器的额外费用，潜袭者必须支付6[credit]。 当潜袭者对总部进行一次成功的潜袭时，将本特性翻面。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, place 2 agenda counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted agenda counter: This run cannot be declared successful. (This effect does not cause the run to become unsuccessful.) Use this ability only during a run.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，放置2枚议案指示物到本议案上。 每回合限一次 → 所附载的议案指示物：本次潜袭不能宣告为成功。（本效果不会导致潜袭被视为失败。）本能力仅能在潜袭中使用。

text_enUS:
When your turn begins, if you have any other rezzed assets, resolve 1 of the following; otherwise, resolve up to 3 in any order:
  • Draw 1 card.
  • Gain 1[credit].
  • Place 1 advancement counter on an installed piece of ice.
  • Add this asset to HQ.
text_zhCN:
当你的回合开始时，如果你有其他的已激活资产，结算下列选项中的1项；否则，以任意顺序结算最多3项：
  • 抽1张卡牌。
  • 获得1[credit]。
  • 放置1枚推进指示物到一层已安装的防火墙上。
  • 将本资产加入总部。

text_enUS:
You can advance this ice.
While there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, this ice gets +3 strength and the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines during each encounter.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. Place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
你可以推进本防火墙。
只要所附载的推进指示物有3枚或更多，本防火墙的强度+3，且每次遭遇中潜袭者不能破解超过1条本防火墙上的印刷子进程。
[subroutine] 获得1[credit]。放置1枚推进指示物到一张已安装的卡牌上。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
You can advance this ice. It gets +1 strength for each hosted advancement counter.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead give the Runner 2 tags.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. If there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters, instead trash 1 installed program and 1 installed resource.
text_zhCN:
你可以推进本防火墙。每有1枚所附载的推进指示物，本防火墙的强度+1。
[subroutine] 给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记。如果所附载的推进指示物有3枚或更多，改为给予潜袭者2枚锁定标记。
[subroutine] 销毁1个已安装的程序。如果所附载的推进指示物有3枚或更多，改为销毁1个已安装的程序与1个已安装的资源。

text_enUS:
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, trash 1 installed program.
[subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, trash 1 installed piece of hardware.
While this ice is protecting HQ, it gains “[subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, end the run.” after its other subroutines.
text_zhCN:
[subroutine] <trace>追踪4</trace> -如果成功，销毁1个已安装的程序。
[subroutine] <trace>追踪3</trace> -如果成功，销毁1个已安装的硬件。
只要本防火墙保护总部，其便在其他所有子进程后获得“[subroutine] <trace>追踪3</trace> -如果成功，终止本次潜袭。”

text_enUS: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on a server protected by ice, do 2 meat damage.
text_zhCN: 只有当前没有正在生效的封锁时，才能打出。直到你的下回合开始前，本事务不会被销毁。 每当潜袭者对一台有防火墙保护的服务器进行一次成功的潜袭时，造成2点肢体伤害。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a piece of ice protecting this server. Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they pay 2[credit] for each advanced piece of ice protecting this server. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，放置1枚推进指示物到1层保护本服务器的防火墙上。 每当潜袭者接驳本服务器时，终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者支付等同于保护本服务器的已推进的防火墙二倍数量的信用点。 每台服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS:
The first time each turn you purge virus counters, gain 4[credit].
When you score this agenda, you may purge virus counters.
text_zhCN:
每回合你第一次清除病毒指示物时，获得4[credit]。
当你将本议案计分时，你可以清除病毒指示物。

text_enUS: Forfeit this agenda: If the Runner has 2 or more [click] remaining, they lose [click][click].
text_zhCN: 废除本议案：如果潜袭者有2个或更多剩余的[click]，其失去[click][click]。

text_enUS: Play only if there is no active lockdown. This operation is not trashed until your next turn begins. As an additional cost to steal an agenda, the Runner must pay 4[credit] plus 2[credit] for each advancement counter on that agenda.
text_zhCN: 只有当前没有正在生效的封锁时，才能打出。直到你的下回合开始前，本事务不会被销毁。作为窃取一个议案的额外费用，潜袭者必须支付4[credit]，并且该议案上每有1枚推进指示物，便额外增加2[credit]。

text_enUS:
When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.
You can spend hosted credits to play events.
When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must trash 1 card from your grip at random or trash this resource.
text_zhCN:
当你的回合开始或你窃取一个议案时，放置1[credit]到本资源上。
你可以花费所附载的信用点以打出事件。
当你的回合结束时，如果所附载的信用点有3个或更多，你必须从你的操控器中随机销毁1张卡牌或者销毁本资源。

text_enUS: +1[mu] The first time each turn you play a run event, gain [click]. Limit 1 console per player.
text_zhCN: +1[mu] 每回合你第一次打出一个潜袭事件时，获得[click]。 每位玩家限制1个控制台。

text_enUS: +1[link] Whenever you install a non-AI icebreaker, that icebreaker gets +2 strength for the remainder of the turn.
text_zhCN: +1[link] 每当你安装一个非智能模块的破解器时，该破解器在本回合剩余时间内强度+2。

text_enUS:
When you score this agenda, if there is another copy of Megaprix Qualifier in either playerʼs score area, place 1 agenda counter on this agenda.
While this agenda has a hosted agenda counter, it is worth 1 more agenda point.
text_zhCN:
当你计分本议案时，如果任一玩家的分数区内有另一张名称为极大奖资格赛的卡牌，放置1枚议案指示物到本议案上。
只要本议案上有所附载的议案指示物，其价值便增加1点议案分数。

text_enUS: Remote server only. When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a card in the root of this server. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在远程服务器。 当你的回合开始时，放置1枚推进指示物到本服务器内的1张卡牌上。 每个服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: Play only if the Runner did not make a successful run on HQ during their last turn. Search R&D for 1 agenda and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that agenda to HQ. You may install 1 card from HQ in the root of a remote server. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.
text_zhCN:
只有潜袭者在其上回合未对总部进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。
在研发中心搜寻1个议案并展示之。(在搜寻研发中心后将其洗混。)将该议案加入总部。你可以安装1张卡牌到一台远程服务器内。你在本回合剩余时间内不能将议案计分。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a piece of ice protecting this server. Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they pay 2[credit] for each advanced piece of ice protecting this server. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，放置1枚推进指示物到1层保护本服务器的防火墙上。 每当潜袭者接驳本服务器时，终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者支付等同于保护本服务器的已推进的防火墙二倍数量的信用点。 每台服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: Trash the top 3 cards of your stack. Shuffle 3 cards from your heap into your stack. Draw 1 card. Remove this event from the game instead of trashing it.
text_zhCN: 销毁你的存储栈顶端的3张卡牌。将3张卡牌从你的堆阵洗入你的存储栈。抽1张卡牌。将本事件移出游戏，代替销毁之。

text_enUS:
When you install this resource, load 3[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card.
When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.
When your turn ends, if you made at least 3 successful runs this turn and this card is in your heap, you may install it, ignoring all costs.
text_zhCN:
当你安装本资源时，填装3[credit]到本资源上。当其清空时，销毁之。
当你的回合开始时，从本资源上拿取1[credit]。
当你的回合结束时，如果你在本回合内进行过至少3次成功的潜袭并且本卡牌在你的堆阵，你可以安装之，忽略所有的费用。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may pay 1[credit] to place 1 power counter on this upgrade. Whenever the Runner makes a successful run, remove 1 power counter from this upgrade. Hosted power counter: End the run. Use this ability only during a run on this server.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以支付1[credit]以放置1枚能量指示物到本升级上。 每当潜袭者进行一次成功的潜袭时，从本升级上移除1枚能量指示物。 所附载的能量指示物：终止本次潜袭。本能力仅能在对本服务器的潜袭中使用。

text_enUS:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they put the top card of the stack on the bottom, then you reveal the top 3 cards of the stack.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] If you revealed 2 or more cards that share a type when this encounter began, gain 3[credit].
[subroutine] If you revealed 3 or more cards that share a type when this encounter began, place 3 advancement tokens on an installed card.
text_zhCN:
当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，其将存储栈顶端的卡牌加入存储栈底端，然后你展示存储栈顶端的3张卡牌。
[subroutine] 潜袭者失去3[credit]。
[subroutine] 如果遭遇开始时所展示的卡牌中有2张或更多卡牌具有相同的类型，获得3[credit]。
[subroutine] 如果遭遇开始时所展示的卡牌中有3张或更多卡牌具有相同的类型，放置3枚推进指示物到一张已安装的卡牌上。

text_enUS:
[trash]: End the run. Use this ability only during a run on this server.

Trash 1 installed program or piece of hardware.
text_zhCN:
只有潜袭者被锁定时，才能打出。
销毁1个已安装的程序或硬件。

text_enUS: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda card and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ.
text_zhCN: 每当你将本服务器根目录中的议案计分时，你可以在研发中心搜寻1张非议案卡牌并展示之。（在搜寻研发中心后将其洗混。）将该卡牌加入总部。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, gain 7[credit].
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，获得7[credit]。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, if the Runner is tagged, do 4 meat damage; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，如果潜袭者被锁定，造成4点肢体伤害；否则，给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记。

text_enUS: When this agenda is scored or stolen, you may rez 1 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs.
text_zhCN: 当本议案被计分或窃取时，你可以激活1层已安装的防火墙，忽略所有的费用。

text_enUS:
When you score this agenda, you may draw 2 cards.
You get +2 maximum hand size.
text_zhCN:
当你将本议案计分时，你可以抽2张卡牌。
你的手牌上限+2。

text_enUS: When you rez this asset, load 15[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Take 3[credit] from this asset.
text_zhCN: 当你激活本资产时，填装15[credit]到本资产上。当其清空时，销毁之。 [click]：从本资产上拿取3[credit]。

text_enUS:
While this ice is protecting a remote server, it gets +2 strength.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
只要本防火墙保护远程服务器，其强度便+2。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit].
text_zhCN:
[subroutine] 造成1点网域伤害。
[subroutine] 获得1[credit]。

text_enUS:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] If the Runner has 6[credit] or less, end the run.
text_zhCN:
[subroutine] 潜袭者失去3[credit]。
[subroutine] 如果潜袭者具有6[credit]或更少，终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS: Gain 9[credit].
text_zhCN: 获得9[credit]。

text_enUS: Starter game only.
text_zhCN: 仅用于起始包对战。

text_enUS: Starter game only.
text_zhCN: 仅用于起始包对战。

text_enUS: Once per turn → 0[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine.
text_zhCN: 0[credit]：破解1条屏障子进程。本能力每回合仅限使用一次。

text_enUS: The first piece of ice the Corp rezzes each turn costs 1[credit] more to rez.
text_zhCN: 每回合公司激活的第一层防火墙的激活费用加1[credit]。

text_enUS:
Play only if you made a successful run this turn.
Trash 1 unrezzed piece of ice you passed during your last run.
text_zhCN:
只有你本回合已进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。
销毁1层你在上一次潜袭中通过的未激活的防火墙。

text_enUS: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, you may install 1 program from your heap, ignoring all costs.
text_zhCN: 潜袭档案库。如果成功，你可以从你的堆阵安装1个程序，忽略所有的费用，代替侵入档案库。

text_enUS:
The Corp cannot score an agenda during the same turn they installed that agenda.
When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this program.
text_zhCN:
公司不能在其安装议案的同一回合将该议案计分。
当公司清除病毒指示物时，销毁本程序。

text_enUS: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
text_zhCN: 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条屏障子进程。 1[credit]：强度+1。

text_enUS: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Access, once per turn → Hosted virus counter: Trash the card you are accessing.
text_zhCN: 当你安装本程序时，放置2枚病毒指示物到本程序上。 读取 → 所附载的病毒指示物：销毁你正在读取的卡牌。本能力每回合仅限使用一次。

text_enUS: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine.
text_zhCN: 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条警报子进程。

text_enUS: While you are encountering a piece of ice, it gets −1 strength.
text_zhCN: 在你遭遇一层防火墙的期间，该防火墙的强度-1。

text_enUS: When you install this resource, load 16[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Take 4[credit] from this resource.
text_zhCN: 当你安装本资源时，填装16[credit]到本资源上。当其清空时，销毁之。 [click]：从本资源上拿取4[credit]。

text_enUS: 2[recurring-credit] (When you install this card and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs.
text_zhCN: 2[recurring-credit] （当你安装本卡牌时及你的回合开始前，将所附载的信用点补充至2个。） 你可以花费所附载的信用点以支付销毁费用。

text_enUS: The rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 1[credit].
text_zhCN: 每层防火墙的激活费用加1[credit]。

text_enUS: The first time each turn you play a run event, gain 1[credit].
text_zhCN: 每回合你第一次打出一个潜袭事件时，获得1[credit]。

text_enUS: The first time each turn you make a successful run on HQ, you may choose 2 cards in your heap. If you do, the Corp removes 1 of those cards from the game, then you add the other card to your grip.
text_zhCN: 每回合你第一次对总部进行成功的潜袭时，你可以选择你堆阵中的2张卡牌。如果你如此做，公司将其中1张卡牌移出游戏，然后你将另1张加入你的操控器。

text_enUS: Install 1 resource from your grip, paying 3[credit] less.
text_zhCN: 从你的操控器安装1个资源，其安装费用减3[credit]。

text_enUS:
Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn.
Derez 1 installed piece of ice.
text_zhCN:
只有你本回合已对总部进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。
关闭1层已安装的防火墙。

text_enUS: Choose 1 unrezzed piece of ice. The Corp may rez that ice. If they do not, they trash it.
text_zhCN: 选择1层未激活的防火墙。公司可以激活该防火墙。如果其未如此做，则其销毁该防火墙。

text_enUS: Run any server. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it.
text_zhCN: 潜袭任意一台服务器。本次潜袭中你第一次遭遇一层防火墙时，略过该防火墙。

text_enUS: Run HQ. If successful, access 2 additional cards when you breach HQ.
text_zhCN: 潜袭总部。如果成功，当你侵入总部时，额外读取2张卡牌。

text_enUS: Remove 1 tag. Then, you may pay 1[credit] to add this event to your grip.
text_zhCN: 移除1枚锁定标记。然后你可以支付1[credit]，以将本事件加入你的操控器。

text_enUS: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength. [trash]: Bypass the code gate you are encountering.
text_zhCN: 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条门禁子进程。 2[credit]：强度+2。 [trash]：略过你当前正在遭遇的门禁。

text_enUS: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +1 strength. When you install this program, choose 1 installed piece of ice. Whenever you encounter the chosen ice, you may pay 1[credit] for each subroutine it has. If you do, bypass that ice.
text_zhCN: 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条警报子进程。 2[credit]：强度+1。 当你安装本程序时，选择1层已安装的防火墙。 每当你遭遇所选择的防火墙时，你可以支付与该防火墙上子进程数量相等的[credit]。如果你如此做，略过该防火墙。

text_enUS: [click]: Run Archives. If that run would be declared successful, change the attacked server to HQ for the remainder of that run.
text_zhCN: [click]：潜袭档案库。如果本次潜袭将要宣告为成功，在本次潜袭的剩余时间内将被攻击的服务器改为总部。

text_enUS:
When your turn begins, you may choose a server.
The first time each turn you make a successful run on the chosen server, instead of breaching it, gain 2[credit].
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以选择一台服务器。本回合你第一次对所选择的服务器进行成功的潜袭时，获得2[credit]，代替侵入该服务器。

text_enUS: Before drawing your starting hand, set aside the top 6 cards of your stack facedown. (You may look at those cards at any time.) Shuffle 2 of those cards into your stack. [click]: Add 1 card set aside with this identity to your grip.
text_zhCN: 在你抽初始手牌前，将你的存储栈顶端6张卡牌面朝下置于一旁。（你可以随时查看这些卡牌。） 将其中2张卡牌洗入你的存储栈。 [click]：将1张由本特性置于一旁的卡牌加入你的操控器。

text_enUS: The first time each turn you encounter a piece of ice, it gains code gate for the remainder of this run.
text_zhCN: 每回合你第一次遭遇一层防火墙时，该防火墙在本次潜袭的剩余时间内获得门禁。

text_enUS: Draw 3 cards.
text_zhCN: 抽3张卡牌。

text_enUS: Search either your stack or your heap for 1 program. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) Install that program, ignoring all costs. When your turn ends, if that program has not been uninstalled, add it to the top of your stack.
text_zhCN: 在你的存储栈或堆阵搜寻1个程序。（如果搜寻了存储栈则将其洗混。）安装该程序，忽略所有的费用。当你的回合结束时，如果该程序仍未被卸载，将其加入你的存储栈顶端。

text_enUS: Run R&D. If successful, access 2 additional cards when you breach R&D.
text_zhCN: 潜袭研发中心。如果成功，当你侵入研发中心时，额外读取2张卡牌。

text_enUS: When you install this program, you may spend any number of credits to place that many power counters on it. This program gets +1 strength for each hosted power counter, and it can only interface with ice of exactly equal strength. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine.
text_zhCN: 当你安装本程序时，你可以支付X[credit]，以放置X枚能量指示物到本程序上。 每有1枚所附载的能量指示物，本程序的强度+1，且本程序只能与强度与其相等的防火墙对接。 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条子进程。

text_enUS: When you install this program, choose barrier, code gate, or sentry. When your discard phase ends, add this program to your grip. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a piece of ice that has the chosen subtype.
text_zhCN: 当你安装本程序时，选择屏障、门禁或或警报。 当你的弃牌阶段结束时，将本程序加入你的操控器。 对接 → 1[credit]：破解一层具有所选择的子类型的防火墙上的1条子进程。

text_enUS: Install only on a rezzed piece of ice. Host ice gains barrier, code gate, and sentry.
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在一层已激活的防火墙上。 被附载的防火墙获得屏障、门禁与警报。

text_enUS: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
text_zhCN: 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条门禁子进程。 1[credit]：本次潜袭的剩余时间内强度+1。

text_enUS: 2[recurring-credit] (When you install this card and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs of assets.
text_zhCN: 2[recurring-credit] （当你安装本卡牌时及你的回合开始前，将所附载的信用点补充至2个。） 你可以花费所附载的信用点以支付资产的销毁费用。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, gain 3[credit].
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以销毁另1张你已安装的卡牌。如果你如此做，获得3[credit]。

text_enUS: [click]: Gain 1[credit] and draw 1 card.
text_zhCN: [click]：获得1[credit]并抽1张卡牌。

text_enUS: Run any server. When that run ends, if it was successful, gain 5[credit].
text_zhCN: 潜袭任意一台服务器。当本次潜袭结束时，如果潜袭成功，获得5[credit]。

text_enUS: 1[recurring-credit] (When you install this card and before your turn begins, refill to 1 hosted credit.) You can spend hosted credits to play events.
text_zhCN: 1[recurring-credit] （当你安装本卡牌时及你的回合开始前，将所附载的信用点补充至1个。） 你可以花费所附载的信用点以打出事件。

text_enUS:
When you install this resource, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it.
When your turn begins, remove 1 hosted power counter and draw 2 cards.
text_zhCN:
当你安装本资源时，填装3枚能量指示物到本资源上。当其清空时，销毁之。
当你的回合开始时，移除1枚所附载的能量指示物并抽2张卡牌。

text_enUS: The first time each turn the Runner passes a rezzed piece of bioroid ice, you may rez 1 bioroid card, paying 4[credit] less.
text_zhCN: 每回合潜袭者第一次通过一层已激活的生化人防火墙时，你可以激活1张生化人卡牌，其激活费用减4[credit]。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，如果所附载的推进指示物超过3枚，每超过1枚，放置1枚议案指示物到本议案上。 所附载的议案指示物：将1张卡牌从档案库加入总部。

text_enUS: When you rez this asset, load 8[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. When your turn begins, take 2[credit] from this asset. [interrupt] → When this asset would be trashed, you may shuffle it into R&D instead of adding it to Archives. (It is still considered trashed.)
text_zhCN: 当你激活本资产时，填装8[credit]到本资产上。当其清空时，销毁之。 当你的回合开始时，从本资产上拿取2[credit]。 [interrupt] → 当本资产将被销毁时，你可以将其洗入研发中心，代替加入档案库。（它仍然视为被销毁。）

text_enUS: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN: 失去[click]：破解1条本防火墙上的子进程。只有潜袭者可以使用本能力。 [subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。 [subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
When you rez this ice, choose 1 installed program hosted on a piece of ice. Host that program on this ice.
Each hosted program loses all abilities and cannot gain abilities.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
当你激活本防火墙时，选择1个已安装且附载于防火墙上的程序。将该程序附载到本防火墙上。
所附载的程序失去所有能力。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Resolve 1 subroutine on another rezzed bioroid ice. [subroutine] Resolve 1 subroutine on another rezzed bioroid ice.
text_zhCN: 失去[click]：破解1条本防火墙上的子进程。只有潜袭者可以使用本能力。 [subroutine] 结算另1层已激活的生化人防火墙上的1条子进程。 [subroutine] 结算另1层已激活的生化人防火墙上的1条子进程。

text_enUS:
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
[subroutine] 销毁1个已安装的程序。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
text_zhCN: 将1张卡牌从档案库加入总部。

text_enUS: Gain [click][click].
text_zhCN: 获得[click][click]。

text_enUS: X[credit], [trash]: Choose 1 rezzed piece of ice protecting this server. That ice gets +X strength for the remainder of the turn.
text_zhCN: X[credit]，[trash]：选择1层已激活的保护本服务器的防火墙。该防火墙在本回合剩余时间内强度+X。

text_enUS: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, do 1 net damage.
text_zhCN: 每当一个议案被计分或窃取时，造成1点网域伤害。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, place 3 agenda counters on it. Hosted agenda counter: Do 1 net damage. Use this ability only during a run and only once per run.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，放置3枚议案指示物到本议案上。 所附载的议案指示物：造成1点网域伤害。本能力仅能在潜袭中使用，且每次潜袭中仅限使用一次。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it. Hosted agenda counter: End the run.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，放置1枚议案指示物到本议案上。 所附载的议案指示物：终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS: You can advance this asset. [click], [trash]: Do 3 net damage. Use this ability only if there are 4 or more hosted advancement counters.
text_zhCN: 你可以推进本资产。 [click]，[trash]：造成3点网域伤害。只有所附载的推进指示物有4枚或更多时，才能使用本能力。

text_enUS:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 4[credit]. If you do, give the Runner 1 tag and do 3 net damage.
text_zhCN:
在潜袭者从研发中心读取本资产的期间，其必须展示之。
当潜袭者从档案库以外其他区域读取本资产时，你可以支付4[credit]。如果你如此做，给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记并造成3点网域伤害。

text_enUS:
The strength of this ice cannot be lowered.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
本防火墙的强度不能被降低。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS: The Runner cannot break subroutines on this ice using AI programs. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed AI program. [subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
text_zhCN: 潜袭者不能使用智能模块程序破解本防火墙上的子进程。 [subroutine] 销毁1个已安装的智能模块程序。 [subroutine] 造成1点网域伤害。

text_enUS:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Reveal up to 5 cards in HQ. Gain 2[credit] for each card you revealed this way.
text_zhCN:
作为打出本事务的额外费用，花费[click]。
展示总部中的最多5张卡牌。你每以此法展示1张卡牌，获得2[credit]。

text_enUS: Choose 1 installed card you can advance. Move up to 2 advancement counters from 1 other card to the chosen card.
text_zhCN: 选择1张你可以推进的已安装的卡牌。从另1张卡牌上转移最多2枚推进指示物到所选择的卡牌上。

text_enUS: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, do 1 net damage. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 每当潜袭者对本服务器进行一次成功的潜袭时，造成1点网域伤害。 每台服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: The first time each turn you create a remote server, draw 1 card.
text_zhCN: 每回合你第一次建立一台远程服务器时，抽1张卡牌。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, you may install and rez 1 asset or upgrade from HQ or Archives, ignoring all costs.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，你可以展示1个总部或档案库内的资产或升级。安装并激活该卡牌，忽略所有的费用。

text_enUS:
When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for every 2 hosted advancement counters past 3.
This agenda is worth 1 more agenda point for each hosted agenda counter.
text_zhCN:
当你将本议案计分时，如果所附载的推进指示物超过3枚，每超过2枚，放置1枚议案指示物到本议案上。
每有1枚所附载的议案指示物，本议案的价值增加1点议案分数。

text_enUS: [interrupt] → The first time each turn you would draw any number of cards, increase the number of cards you will draw by 1. When you draw those cards, add 1 of them to the bottom of R&D.
text_zhCN: [interrupt] → 每回合你第一次将要抽任意数量的卡牌时，抽牌数量增加1张。当你抽这些卡牌时，将其中1张加入研发中心底端。

text_enUS: You can advance this asset. [click], [trash]: The Runner loses 4[credit] for each hosted advancement counter.
text_zhCN: 你可以推进本资产。 [click]，[trash]：每有1枚所附载的推进指示物，潜袭者失去4[credit]。

text_enUS:
When the Runner encounters this ice, gain 1[credit].
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 1[credit].
text_zhCN:
当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，你获得1[credit]。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者支付1[credit]。

text_enUS:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they must pay 3[credit], if able. If they do not, end the run.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，如可能，其必须支付3[credit]。如果其未如此做，终止本次潜袭。

text_zhCN: 每回合你第一次进行成功的潜袭时，你可以销毁另1张你已安装的卡牌，以从你的存储栈搜寻1张同类型的卡牌。（在搜寻存储栈后将其洗混。）安装你搜寻到的卡牌，其安装费用减3[credit]。

text_enUS: When you install this resource, load 2 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click], hosted power counter: Draw 3 cards.
text_zhCN: 当你安装本资源时，填装2枚能量指示物到本资源上。当其清空时，销毁之。 [click]，所附载的能量指示物：抽3张卡牌。

text_enUS: Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of any card.
text_zhCN: 你的牌组中每种同名卡牌限1张。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, turn each hosted card faceup. [click]: Host a copy of Matryoshka from your grip faceup on this program. (It is not installed.) Interface → X[credit], turn 1 hosted copy of Matryoshka facedown: Break X subroutines. 1[credit]: +1 strength. Limit 6 per deck.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，将所附载的所有卡牌翻至牌面朝上。 [click]：从你的操控器中将一张名称为套娃的卡牌牌面朝上附载到本程序上。（它没有被安装。） 对接 → X[credit]，将1张所附载的名称为套娃的卡牌翻至牌面朝下：破解X条子进程。 1[credit]：强度+1。 每套牌组限制6张。

text_enUS: Whenever the Runner steals an agenda, do 1 core damage unless they spend [click] and 2[credit].
text_zhCN: 每当一个议案被窃取时，造成1点核心伤害，除非潜袭者花费[click]与2[credit]。

text_enUS: This agenda gets -1 advancement requirement for each core damage the Runner has taken this game.
text_zhCN: 潜袭者本局游戏中每受到过1点核心伤害，本议案的推进需求-1。

text_enUS:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, they may add it to their score area as an agenda worth -1 agenda point. If they do not, do 1 core damage and remove this asset from the game.
text_zhCN:
在潜袭者从研发中心读取本资产的期间，其必须展示之。
当潜袭者读取本资产时，其可以将本资产加入其分数区，作为一个价值-1点议案分数的议案。如果其不如此做，造成1点核心伤害，并将本资产移出游戏。

text_enUS: As an additional cost to rez this ice, derez another piece of harmonic ice. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
text_zhCN: 作为激活本防火墙的额外费用，关闭另一层和声防火墙。 [subroutine] 造成1点核心伤害。 [subroutine] 销毁1个已安装的程序。 [subroutine] 销毁1个已安装的程序。

text_enUS: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, the Runner loses [click]. [subroutine] The Runner loses 1[credit] for each rezzed piece of harmonic ice. [subroutine] End the run unless the Runner spends [click].
text_zhCN: 在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，潜袭者失去[click]。 [subroutine] 每有1层已激活的和声防火墙，潜袭者失去1[credit]。 [subroutine] 终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者花费[click]。

text_enUS:
As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click].
Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn.
Give the Runner 1 tag.
text_zhCN:
作为打出本事务的额外费用，花费[click]。
只有潜袭者在其上回合窃取过议案时，才能打出。
给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记。

text_enUS:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Do 1 core damage. The Runner gets -1 allotted [click] for their next turn.
Remove this operation from the game.
text_zhCN:
只有潜袭者被锁定时，才能打出。
造成1点核心伤害。潜袭者在其下回合获得的起始[click]数量-1。
将本事务移出游戏。

text_enUS: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, do 1 core damage. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 每当你将本服务器根目录中的议案计分时，造成1点核心伤害。 每台服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: When the Runner accesses this upgrade while it is installed, you may pay 2[credit] to do 1 core damage. If the Runner has any [click] remaining, they may lose all their [click] to prevent this damage.
text_zhCN: 当潜袭者读取已安装的本升级时，你可以花费2[credit]以造成1点核心伤害。如果潜袭者有剩余的[click]，其可以失去其所有[click]，以防止本伤害。

text_enUS:
Whenever you score an agenda that you did not install or advance this turn, place 1 power counter on this identity.
For each hosted power counter, you need 1 less agenda point to win the game.
text_zhCN:
每当你将一个你并未在本回合安装或推进的议案计分时，放置1枚能量指示物到本卡牌上。
每有1枚所附载的能量指示物，你赢得游戏胜利所需的议案分数减1。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, you may install 1 facedown card from Archives.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，你可以从档案库安装1张牌面朝下的卡牌。

text_enUS:
When you rez this asset and when your turn begins, place 1 power counter on this asset.
The Runner gets -1 maximum hand size for each hosted power counter.
text_zhCN:
当你激活本资产时及你的回合开始时，放置1枚能量指示物到本资产上。
每有1枚所附载的能量指示物，潜袭者的手牌上限-1。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 2 net damage.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以销毁本资产，以造成2点网域伤害。

text_enUS:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may trash 1 card from HQ. If you do, choose 1 installed Runner card. That cardʼs abilities cannot break subroutines for the remainder of that run.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，你可以从总部销毁1张卡牌。如果你如此做，选择1张已安装的潜袭者卡牌。在本次潜袭的剩余时间内，该卡牌的能力不能破解子进程。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] You may draw 1 or 2 cards.
text_zhCN:
[subroutine] 潜袭者失去2[credit]。
[subroutine] 获得2[credit]。
[subroutine] 造成2点网域伤害。
[subroutine] 你可以抽1或2张卡牌。

text_enUS:
Trash up to 5 cards from HQ. Shuffle that many cards from Archives into R&D. Draw that many cards.
Remove this operation from the game.
text_zhCN:
从总部销毁最多5张卡牌。将等量的卡牌从档案库洗入研发中心。抽等量的卡牌。
将本事务移出游戏。

text_enUS: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may turn 1 facedown piece of ice in Archives faceup. If you do, resolve 1 subroutine on that ice. Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 每当潜袭者接驳本服务器时，你可以将档案库中1层牌面朝下的防火墙翻至牌面朝上。如果你如此做，结算该防火墙上的1条子进程。 每台服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS: This agenda gets -1 advancement requirement for each tag the Runner has.
text_zhCN: 潜袭者每有1枚锁定标记，本议案的推进需求-1。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, you may draw 1 card.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，你可以抽1张卡牌。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may trash this asset. If you do, search R&D for an operation and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that operation to HQ.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以销毁本资产。如果你如此做，从研发中心搜寻一个事务并展示之。（在搜寻研发中心后将其洗混。）将该事务加入总部。

text_enUS: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may reveal the grip. Trash 1 card revealed this way.
text_zhCN: 每当一个议案被计分或窃取时，你可以展示操控器。销毁1张以此法被展示的卡牌。

text_enUS:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may have the Runner gain 2[credit]. If you do, choose 1 installed resource. That resource loses all abilities until your next turn ends.
[subroutine] End the run.
text_zhCN:
在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，你可以令潜袭者获得2[credit]。如果你如此做，选择1个已安装的资源。该资源失去所有能力，直到你的下回合结束。
[subroutine] 终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may have the Runner gain 2[credit]. If you do, during each encounter with this ice for the remainder of that run, the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] You may draw 2 cards.
text_zhCN:
在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，你可以令潜袭者获得2[credit]。如果你如此做，在本次潜袭的剩余时间内，每次遭遇本防火墙期间，潜袭者不能破解超过1条本防火墙上的印刷子进程。
[subroutine] 给予潜袭者1枚锁定标记。
[subroutine] 造成2点网域伤害。
[subroutine] 你可以抽2张卡牌。

text_enUS: Gain 5[credit]. You may have each player gain 2[credit].
text_zhCN: 获得5[credit]。你可以令双方玩家各获得2[credit]。

text_enUS:
Play only if the Runner has at least 2 tags.
Place a total of 4 advancement counters on installed cards you can advance.
text_zhCN:
只有潜袭者具有至少2枚锁定标记时，才能打出。
放置合计4枚推进指示物到已安装且可被推进的卡牌上。

text_enUS: For each bad publicity you have up to 4, this agenda gets −1 advancement requirement.
text_zhCN: 你每有1枚负面声誉标记，本议案的推进需求-1（最多-4）。

text_enUS: When you score this agenda, you may trash 1 of your rezzed cards. If you do, trash 1 installed Runner card with a printed install cost equal to or less than the printed rez cost of the Corp card you trashed.
text_zhCN: 当你将本议案计分时，你可以销毁1张你的已激活卡牌。如果你如此做，销毁1张已安装的潜袭者卡牌，其印刷安装费用须等于或小于你所销毁公司卡牌的印刷激活费用。

text_enUS: The first time each turn the Runner trashes any of your installed cards (including this asset), do 2 meat damage.
text_zhCN: 每回合潜袭者第一次销毁你已安装的卡牌时（包括本资产），造成2点肢体伤害。

text_enUS:
When you rez this asset, load 6 bad publicity counters onto it. When it is empty, you win the game.
When your turn begins, take 1 bad publicity from this asset.
text_zhCN:
当你激活本资产时，填装6枚负面声誉标记到本资产上。当其清空时，你获得游戏胜利。
当你的回合开始时，从本资产上拿取1枚负面声誉标记。

text_enUS:
When the Runner encounters this ice, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, the Runner cannot break this iceʼs printed subroutines for the remainder of this encounter.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. The Runner loses 1[credit].
[subroutine] The Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.
text_zhCN:
当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，你可以销毁另1张你已安装的卡牌。如果你如此做，潜袭者在本次遭遇的剩余时间内不能破解本防火墙上的印刷子进程。
[subroutine] 获得1[credit]。潜袭者失去1[credit]。
[subroutine] 潜袭者销毁1张其已安装的卡牌。

text_enUS:
As an additional cost to play this operation, remove 1 tag.
Do 4 meat damage.
text_zhCN:
作为打出本事务的额外费用，移除1枚锁定标记。
造成4点肢体伤害。

text_enUS: Whenever a player trashes a card (including this upgrade) from the root of this server or protecting it, except during installation, gain 2[credit].
text_zhCN: 每当一位玩家在非安装过程中销毁本服务器根目录中或保护本服务器的一张卡牌（包括本升级）时，你获得2[credit]。

text_enUS: Remote server only. Each piece of ice protecting this server gains "When the Runner encounters this ice, choose 1 subroutine on it. You may trash this ice to resolve that subroutine.". Limit 1 region per server.
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在远程服务器。 保护本服务器的每层防火墙获得“当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，选择本防火墙上的1条子进程。你可以销毁本防火墙，以结算该子进程。” 每台服务器限制1个区域。

text_enUS:
Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of any card.
Your deck may include up to 2 different agenda cards from each Corp faction.
text_zhCN:
你的牌组中每种同名卡牌限1张。
你的牌组中可以包含来自每个公司派系的最多2张不同议案。

text_enUS:
Gain 4[credit].
When this event is trashed from your grip or stack, you may gain 2[credit].
text_zhCN:
获得4[credit]。
当本事件从你的操控器或存储栈被销毁时，你可以获得2[credit]。

text_enUS: Trash the top 4 cards of your stack. You may install 1 of those cards, paying 3[credit] less.
text_zhCN: 销毁你的存储栈顶端的4张卡牌。你可以安装其中1张，其安装费用减3[credit]。

text_enUS:
The first time each turn you trash a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this hardware.
When your turn begins, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to draw 1 card or remove 1 tag.
text_zhCN:
每回合你第一次销毁一张公司卡牌时，放置1枚能量指示物到本硬件上。
当你的回合开始时，你可以移除1枚所附载的能量指示物，以抽1张卡牌或移除1枚锁定标记。

text_enUS: Whenever you trash a card you are accessing, place 1 virus counter on this program. Interface → Hosted virus counter: Break up to 2 subroutines. Trash 1 card from your grip: +3 strength.
text_zhCN: 每当你销毁一张你正在读取的卡牌时，放置1枚病毒指示物到本程序上。 对接 → 所附载的病毒指示物：破解最多2条子进程。 从你的操控器销毁1张卡牌：强度+3。

text_enUS: Interface → 2[credit]: Subroutines on the barrier you are encountering cannot end the run for the remainder of this encounter.
text_zhCN: 对接 → 2[credit]：本次遭遇的剩余时间内，当前正在遭遇的屏障上的子进程不能终止本次潜袭。

text_enUS:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Host ice gets −2 strength. Each other piece of ice protecting this server gets −1 strength.
text_zhCN:
仅能安装在一层防火墙上。
被附载的防火墙的强度-2。所有其它保护本服务器的防火墙的强度-1。

text_enUS: Once per turn → [click], take 1 tag: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, breach R&D. Threat 3 → Whenever you breach R&D during a run on Archives, access 1 additional card. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
text_zhCN: 每回合限一次 → [click]，拿取1枚锁定标记：潜袭档案库。如果成功，侵入研发中心，代替侵入档案库。 威胁3 → 每当你在对档案库的潜袭中侵入研发中心时，额外读取1张卡牌。（本能力在任一玩家有3点或更多议案分数时生效。）

text_enUS: Once per turn → [click]: Gain [click]. Run a remote server. When that run ends, if it was unsuccessful, take 1 tag. [click], [trash]: Gain [click][click]. Remove 1 tag.
text_zhCN: 每回合限一次 → [click]：获得[click]。潜袭一台远程服务器。当本次潜袭结束时，如果潜袭失败，拿取1枚锁定标记。 [click]，[trash]：获得[click][click]。移除1枚锁定标记。

text_enUS: The first time each turn the Corp installs a card in the root of a server, you may trash the top card of your stack to draw 1 card.
text_zhCN: 每回合公司第一次在一台服务器的根目录中安装一张卡牌时，你可以销毁你的存储栈顶端的卡牌，以抽1张卡牌。

text_enUS: Once per turn → When you breach HQ or R&D during a run, if you did not break any subroutines during that run, you may access 1 additional card.
text_zhCN: 每回合限一次 → 当你在一次潜袭中侵入总部或研发中心时，如果你在本次潜袭中没有破解过子进程，你可以额外读取1张卡牌。

text_enUS: The Corp may reveal an agenda from HQ. If they do, gain [click] and draw 1 card. Otherwise, look at the top 3 cards of R&D.
text_zhCN: 公司可以从总部展示一个议案。如果其如此做，你获得[click]并抽1张卡牌。否则，你查看研发中心顶端的3张卡牌。

text_enUS: Run a central server. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it. Threat 4 → The second time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, you may spend [click] to bypass it. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.)
text_zhCN: 潜袭一台中央服务器。本次潜袭中你第一次遭遇一层防火墙时，略过该防火墙。 威胁4 → 本次潜袭中你第二次遭遇一层防火墙时，你可以花费[click]，以略过该防火墙。（本能力在任一玩家有4点或更多议案分数时生效。）

text_enUS: Whenever you bypass a piece of ice, you may remove this hardware from the game to derez that ice.
text_zhCN: 每当你略过一层防火墙时，你可以将本硬件移出游戏，以关闭该防火墙。

text_enUS: +1[mu] Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, add 1 unrezzed card to HQ. Limit 1 console per player.
text_zhCN: +1[mu] 每当一个议案被计分或窃取时，你将1张未激活的卡牌加入总部。 每位玩家限制1个控制台。

text_enUS: Whenever you encounter a barrier, you may spend 3 hosted power counters to bypass it. Whenever this program fully breaks a piece of ice, place 1 power counter on this program. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
text_zhCN: 每当你遭遇一层屏障时，你可以花费3枚所附载的能量指示物，以略过该防火墙。 每当本程序完全破解一层防火墙时，放置1枚能量指示物到本程序上。 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条屏障子进程。 1[credit]：强度+1。

text_enUS: Whenever you encounter a piece of AP, destroyer, or observer ice, you may trash this program to bypass that ice.
text_zhCN: 每当你遭遇一层杀伤、毁灭者或观察者防火墙时，你可以销毁本程序，以略过该防火墙。

text_enUS:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever host ice is rezzed or derezzed, gain 3[credit].
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在一层防火墙上。每当被附载的防火墙被激活或关闭时，获得3[credit]。

text_enUS: Threat 4 → This program gets −2 strength. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
text_zhCN: 威胁4 → 本程序的强度-2。（本能力在任一玩家有4点或更多议案分数时生效。） 对接 → 1[credit]：破解1条门禁子进程。 2[credit]：强度+2。

text_enUS: Threat 4 → When you install this resource, place 2[credit] on it. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Whenever you play a run event, place 1[credit] on this resource. [click]: Run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.
text_zhCN: 威胁4 → 当你安装本资源时，放置2[credit]到本资源上。（本能力在任一玩家有4点或更多议案分数时生效。） 每当你打出一个潜袭事件时，放置1[credit]到本资源上。 [click]：潜袭任意一台服务器。你可以在本次潜袭中花费所附载的信用点。

text_enUS: Once per turn → 0[credit]: Install 1 program from your grip (paying its install cost). Use this ability only during a run. When that run ends, trash that program if it is not a trojan.
text_zhCN: 每回合限一次 → 0[credit]：从你的操控器安装1个程序（支付所有的费用）。本能力仅能在潜袭中使用。当本次潜袭结束时，如果该程序不是木马，销毁该程序。

text_enUS: Run R&D. If successful, draw 5 cards.
text_zhCN: 潜袭研发中心。如果成功，抽5张卡牌。

text_enUS: When you install this hardware, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent 1 net damage. Use this ability only during a run. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent a "when encountered" ability on a piece of ice.
text_zhCN: 当你安装本硬件时，填装3枚能量指示物到本硬件上。当其清空时，销毁之。 [interrupt] → 所附载的能量指示物：防止1点网域伤害。本能力仅能在潜袭中使用。 [interrupt] → 所附载的能量指示物：防止一层防火墙上的一项“遭遇时”能力。

text_enUS: +2[mu] The first time each turn you install a program, you may draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.

text_enUS:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever you pass host ice, you may gain [click]. If this is not the first time you gained [click] during a run this turn, add this program to your grip.

仅能安装在一层防火墙上。

text_enUS: Install only on a piece of ice. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on host ice. Use this ability only once per encounter.
text_zhCN: 仅能安装在一层防火墙上。 对接 → 1[credit]：破解被附载的防火墙上的1条子进程。本能力每次遭遇仅限使用一次。

text_enUS: This program can only interface with ice hosting a trojan program. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 3 code gate subroutines. If at least 1 subroutine was broken this way, each player may draw 1 card.
text_zhCN: 本程序只能与被木马程序附载的防火墙对接。 对接 → 2[credit]：破解最多3条门禁子进程。如果以此法破解了至少1条子进程，双方玩家各可以抽1张卡牌。

text_enUS: [click][click]: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, breach R&D. When you do, access 1 additional card.
text_zhCN: [click][click]：潜袭总部。如果成功，侵入研发中心，代替侵入总部。当你如此做时，额外读取1张卡牌。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may add 1 installed non-virus trojan program to your grip. If you do, place 2[credit] on this resource. You can spend hosted credits to install cards.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以将1个已安装的非病毒的木马程序加入你的操控器。如果你如此做，放置2[credit]到本资源上。 你可以花费所附载的信用点以安装卡牌。

text_enUS:
Run any server. If successful, resolve 2 of the following in any order:
  • Draw 2 cards.
  • Install 1 card from your grip, paying 1[credit] less.
  • Remove 1 tag.
  • Place 4[credit] on this event. You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs for the remainder of this run.
text_zhCN:
潜袭任意一台服务器。如果成功，按任意顺序结算下列中的2项：
  • 抽2张卡牌。
  • 从你的操控器安装1张卡牌，其安装费用减1[credit]。
  • 移除1枚锁定标记。
  • 放置4[credit]到本事件上。在本次潜袭的剩余时间内，你可以花费所附载的信用点以支付销毁费用。

text_enUS: Whenever you score an agenda (including this one), you may do 1 core damage.
text_zhCN: 每当你将一个议案计分时（包括本议案在内），你可以造成1点核心伤害。

text_enUS: Each run, as long as a piece of ice has been derezzed during that run, each installed icebreaker gets –2 strength. Once per turn → When a run begins, you may derez 1 piece of ice not protecting the attacked server to gain 1[credit].
text_zhCN: 每次潜袭中，只要一层防火墙被关闭过，每个已安装的破解器的强度便-2。 每回合限一次 → 当一次潜袭开始时，你可以关闭1层并非保护当前被攻击服务器的防火墙，以获得1[credit]。

text_enUS: Whenever you finish taking an action, if you have taken that action exactly 3 times this turn, gain [click].
text_zhCN: 每当你执行完一个行动，如果你本回合恰好执行过3次该行动，获得[click]。

text_enUS: Threat 3 → When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may install 1 non-agenda card from HQ or Archives in the root of or protecting another server. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] End the run.

text_enUS: The rez cost of each piece of ice protecting this server is lowered by 2[credit]. Threat 4 → The rez cost of each card in the root of this server is lowered by 2[credit]. The first time each turn you install a card in the root of or protecting a remote server, you may install 1 card from HQ in the root of or protecting another remote server, ignoring all costs. You cannot score the second card this turn.

限制2台远程服务器。

text_zhCN: 当本议案被计分或窃取时，造成2点网域伤害。

每回合第一次对档案库的潜袭开始时，如果没有防火墙保护本服务器，造成2点网域伤害。

text_enUS:
Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Gain 4[credit] and draw 2 cards. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
  • Do X net damage. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has, up to 3.

  • 获得4[credit]并抽2张卡牌。将1张卡牌从总部加入到研发中心顶端。
  • 造成X点网域伤害。X等于潜袭者的锁定标记数量（最多为3）。

text_enUS: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, the Runner cannot access cards other than this upgrade for the remainder of that run. If the bids match, the Runner cannot access this upgrade for the remainder of that run. When your turn ends, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server.
text_zhCN: 每当潜袭者对本服务器进行一次成功的潜袭时，进行一次灵能博弈。（双方玩家秘密决定0-2的数值，然后同时宣告并花费所声明数值的[credit]。）如果二者数值不同，在本次潜袭的剩余时间内，潜袭者不能读取除本升级以外的卡牌。如果二者数值相同，在本次潜袭的剩余时间内，潜袭者不能读取本升级。 当你的回合结束时，你可以将本升级转移到另一台服务器的根目录。

text_enUS:
As an additional cost to trash this upgrade, the Runner must add 2 cards from the grip at random to the bottom of the stack.
Persistent → As an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root, the Runner must add 2 cards from the grip at random to the bottom of the stack.

持久 → 作为从本服务器或其根目录窃取一个议案的额外费用，潜袭者必须从操控器随机将2张卡牌加入存储栈底端。

text_enUS: The first time each turn the Runner steals or trashes a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this identity. [click], hosted power counter: Look at the top 3 cards of R&D. You may install 1 of those cards.
text_zhCN: 每回合第一次潜袭者窃取或销毁一张公司卡牌时，放置1枚能量指示物到本特性上。 [click]，所附载的能量指示物：查看研发中心顶端的3张卡牌。你可以安装其中1张卡牌。

text_enUS: When the Runner steals this agenda, give them 1 tag. [click], remove 1 tag: Shuffle this agenda into R&D. The Corp can use this ability only if this agenda is in the Runner's score area.
text_zhCN: 当潜袭者窃取本议案时，给予其1枚锁定标记。 [click]，移除1枚锁定标记：将本议案洗入研发中心。只有本议案在潜袭者的分数区时，公司才能使用本能力。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may choose a card type to look at the top card of R&D. If that card has the chosen type, you may reveal it and gain 2[credit].
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以选择一种卡牌类型，以查看研发中心顶端的卡牌。如果该卡牌具有所选择的类型，你可以展示之并获得2[credit]。

text_enUS:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.

在潜袭者从研发中心读取本资产的期间，其必须展示之。
当潜袭者从档案库以外其他区域读取本资产时，你可以支付4[credit]，以给予其2枚锁定标记。

text_enUS: When your turn begins, you may look at the top 3 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order. Then, if this server is not protected by ice, you may draw 1 card.
text_zhCN: 当你的回合开始时，你可以查看研发中心顶端的3张卡牌，并按任意顺序排列它们。然后，如果如果没有防火墙保护本服务器，你可以抽1张卡牌。

text_enUS:
Threat 4 → When the Runner encounters this ice, it gains X "[subroutine] End the run." subroutines for the remainder of this run, after its other subroutines. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has.

[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.

text_zhCN: 作为打出本事务的额外费用，花费[click]。 在研发中心搜寻1个事务或议案并展示之。（在搜寻研发中心后将其洗混。）将该卡牌加入总部。 威胁3 → 你可以从总部打出或安装1张卡牌。（本能力在任一玩家有3点或更多议案分数时生效。）

text_enUS: Threat 3 → [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this upgrade from HQ: Do 1 meat damage. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) When the Runner accesses this upgrade while it is rezzed, you may pay 2[credit] to do 2 meat damage.
